none: PAS CAM-6CFF11: Roman Coin : A copper-alloy contemporary copy of a nummus of the House of Constantine
contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

A copper-alloy contemporary copy of a nummus of the House of Constantine, AD 330-335, (Reece period 17). Reverse shows Victory on prow. Mint is Lyons. See RIC VII, p.138, no.246. Obverse shows helmeted bust left. Obverse legend reads CONSTANTINOPOLIS. Mint mark is -/-//.PLG, L is reversed in mintmark. Die axis is 9 o'clock, weight is 1.15g, diameter is 14.50mm
